26940.name: Ecsit
26940.otherdesignations: evolutionarily conserved signaling intermediate in Toll pathway, mitochondrial|ECSIT homolog|signaling intermediate in Toll pathway-evolutionarily conserved
26940.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and chromatin binding activity. Acts upstream of or within BMP signaling pathway; mesoderm formation; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in mitochondrion. Part of transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in egg cylinder; embryo mesoderm; and genitourinary system. Orthologous to human ECSIT (ECSIT signaling integrator). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
